traditions.KJV: And [ David ] made him houses in the city of David ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֤כֶן מָקוֹם֙ לַֽ אֲר֣וֹן הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֔ים

1.english_reference: and pitched for it a tent

traditions.KJV: None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites :

2.english_reference: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever

traditions.WLC: כִּי בָ֣ ם בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לָ שֵׂ֞את אֶת אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה וּֽ לְ שָׁרְת֖ וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם

traditions.VUL: quos elégit Dóminus ad portándum eam , et ad ministrándum sibi usque in ætérnum .
traditions.KJV: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God , and to minister unto him for ever .

3.english_reference: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּקְהֵ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם

traditions.VUL: Congregavítque univérsum Israel in Ierúsalem ,

3.english_reference: to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it

traditions.WLC: לְ הַעֲלוֹת֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מְקוֹמ֖ וֹ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִ֥ין לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τοῦ ἀνενέγκαι τὴν κιβωτὸν Κυρίου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἡτοίμασεν αὐτῇ .
traditions.VUL: ut afferrétur arca Dei in locum suum , quem præparáverat ei :
traditions.KJV: to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place , which he had prepared for it .

4.english_reference: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites

traditions.WLC: וַ יֶּאֱסֹ֥ף דָּוִ֛יד אֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַֽהֲרֹ֖ן וְ אֶת הַ לְוִיִּֽם

traditions.LXX: Οὐριὴλ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν δέκα ·
traditions.VUL: Uriel princeps fuit , et fratres eius centum vigínti .
traditions.KJV: Uriel the chief , and his brethren an hundred and twenty :

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י
traditions.LXX: τῶν υἱῶν Μερραρεί ,
traditions.VUL: De fíliis Merári ,
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Merari ;

6.english_reference: Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty

traditions.WLC: עֲשָׂיָ֣ה הַ שָּׂ֔ר וְ אֶחָ֖י ו מָאתַ֥יִם וְ עֶשְׂרִֽים
traditions.LXX: Ἀσαὶ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι πεντήκοντα ·

traditions.LXX: τῶν υἱῶν Γηρσάμ ,

traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Gershom ;

7.english_reference: Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty

traditions.WLC: יוֹאֵ֣ל הַ שָּׂ֔ר וְ אֶחָ֖י ו מֵאָ֥ה וּ שְׁלֹשִֽׁים

traditions.VUL: Ioel princeps : et fratres eius centum trigínta .
traditions.KJV: Joel the chief , and his brethren an hundred and thirty :

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנֵ֖י אֱלִֽיצָפָ֑ן
traditions.LXX: τῶν υἱῶν Ἐλεισαφάτ ,
traditions.VUL: De fíliis Elísaphan ,
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Elizaphan ;

8.english_reference: Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred

traditions.WLC: שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה הַ שָּׂ֖ר וְ אֶחָ֥י ו מָאתָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: Σαμαίας ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι ·
traditions.VUL: Semeías princeps : et fratres eius ducénti .
traditions.KJV: Shemaiah the chief , and his brethren two hundred :

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: τῶν υἱῶν Χεβρών ,
traditions.VUL: De fíliis Hebron ,
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Hebron ;

9.english_reference: Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore

traditions.WLC: אֱלִיאֵ֥ל הַ שָּׂ֖ר וְ אֶחָ֥י ו שְׁמוֹנִֽים
traditions.LXX: Ἐνὴρ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα ·
traditions.VUL: Eliel princeps : et fratres eius octogínta .
traditions.KJV: Eliel the chief , and his brethren fourscore :

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: τῶν υἱῶν Ὀζειήλ ,
traditions.VUL: De fíliis Oziel ,
traditions.KJV: Of the sons of Uzziel ;

10.english_reference: Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve

traditions.WLC: עַמִּינָדָ֣ב הַ שָּׂ֔ר וְ אֶחָ֕י ו מֵאָ֖ה וּ שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
traditions.LXX: Ἀμειναδὰβ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν δέκα δύο .
traditions.VUL: Amínadab princeps : et fratres eius centum duódecim .
traditions.KJV: Amminadab the chief , and his brethren an hundred and twelve .

11.english_reference: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָ֣א דָוִ֔יד לְ צָד֥וֹק וּ לְ אֶבְיָתָ֖ר הַ כֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים

traditions.KJV: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests ,

11.english_reference: and for the Levites , for Uriel , Asaiah , and Joel , Shemaiah , and Eliel , and Amminadab

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ לְוִיִּ֗ם לְ אֽוּרִיאֵ֤ל עֲשָׂיָה֙ וְ יוֹאֵ֣ל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וֶ אֱלִיאֵ֖ל וְ עַמִּינָדָֽב

traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς
traditions.VUL: et dixit ad eos :
traditions.KJV: And said unto them ,

traditions.WLC: אַתֶּ֛ם רָאשֵׁ֥י הָ אָב֖וֹת לַ לְוִיִּ֑ם

traditions.VUL: Vos qui estis príncipes familiárum Leviticárum ,
traditions.KJV: Ye [ are ] the chief of the fathers of the Levites :

12.english_reference: sanctify yourselves , [ both ] ye and your brethren

traditions.WLC: הִֽתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ אַתֶּ֣ם וַ אֲחֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: ἁγνίσθητε ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: sanctificámini cum frátribus vestris ,
traditions.KJV: sanctify yourselves , [ both ] ye and your brethren ,

12.english_reference: that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto [ the place that ] I have prepared for it

traditions.WLC: וְ הַֽעֲלִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνοίσετε τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ Ἰσραὴλ οὗ ἡτοίμασα αὐτῇ .
traditions.VUL: et afférte arcam Dómini Dei Israel ad locum , qui ei præparátus est :
traditions.KJV: that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto [ the place that ] I have prepared for it .

13.english_reference: For because ye [ did it ] not at the first

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י לְ מַ בָּ רִ֥אשׁוֹנָ֖ה לֹ֣א אַתֶּ֑ם

traditions.VUL: ne ut a príncipio , quia non erátis præséntes ,
traditions.KJV: For because ye [ did it ] not at the first ,

13.english_reference: the LORD our God made a breach upon us

traditions.WLC: פָּרַ֨ץ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י נוּ֙ בָּ֔ נוּ

13.english_reference: for that we sought him not after the due order

traditions.WLC: כִּי לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖ הוּ כַּ מִּשְׁפָּֽט
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἐζητήσαμεν ἐν κρίματι .
traditions.KJV: for that we sought him not after the due order .

14.english_reference: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֑ם לְ הַעֲל֕וֹת אֶת אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡγνίσθησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται τοῦ ἀνενέγκαι τὴν κιβωτὸν θεοῦ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: Sanctificáti sunt ergo sacerdótes , et Levítæ , ut portárent arcam Dómini Dei Israel .
traditions.KJV: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel .

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂא֣וּ בְנֵֽי הַ לְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλαβον οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν Λευειτῶν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Et tulérunt fílii Levi arcam Dei ,
traditions.KJV: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God

15.english_reference: upon their shoulders with the staves thereon ,

traditions.KJV: upon their shoulders with the staves thereon ,

15.english_reference: as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה כִּ דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὡς ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς ἐν λόγῳ θεοῦ κατὰ τὴν γραφήν ,
traditions.VUL: sicut præcéperat Móyses iuxta verbum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD .

15.english_reference: upon their shoulders with the staves thereon

traditions.VUL: húmeris suis in véctibus .

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִיד֮ לְ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ לְוִיִּם֒ לְ הַֽעֲמִ֗יד אֶת אֲחֵי הֶם֙ הַ מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים בִּ כְלֵי שִׁ֛יר

traditions.VUL: Dixítque David princípibus Levitárum , ut constitúerent de frátribus suis cantóres in órganis musicórum ,

traditions.WLC: נְבָלִ֥ים וְ כִנֹּר֖וֹת וּ מְצִלְתָּ֑יִם

traditions.VUL: nablis vidélicet , et lyris , et cýmbalis ,
traditions.KJV: psalteries and harps and cymbals ,

traditions.WLC: מַשְׁמִיעִ֥ים לְ הָרִֽים בְּ ק֖וֹל לְ שִׂמְחָֽה

traditions.VUL: ut resonáret in excélsis sónitus lætítiæ .
traditions.KJV: sounding , by lifting up the voice with joy .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ הַ לְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הֵימָ֣ן בֶּן יוֹאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστησαν οἱ Λευεῖται τὸν Αἱμὰν υἱὸν Ἰωήλ ·
traditions.VUL: Constituerúntque Levítas : Heman fílium Ioel ,
traditions.KJV: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel ;

17.english_reference: and of his brethren , Asaph the son of Berechiah
